en: A black‑and‑white view down a narrow cobblestone street lined with old wooden and stone houses. On the left runs a high medieval stone wall; in the distance rises a cylindrical defensive tower with a conical roof. A wrought‑iron street lamp appears prominently on the right foreground, fixed to a building facade. The scene has an early‑20th‑century European atmosphere. The lower left corner bears the signature or credit "P. PARIKAS".
